body:
T-153 was an owner type drift (None assigned where Issue.owner is declared str) that no test could catch because it was externally invisible. A static type checker would catch this whole class mechanically.

Now that scripts/dev/check exists (T-152), add a type check to it:
- pick mypy or pyright; pin it in scripts/dev/requirements.txt
- run it over scripts/gittoc and scripts/gittoc_lib (tests optional)
- start permissive if needed (e.g. mypy without --strict) and tighten over time

Caveat: a first run on a not-previously-checked codebase may surface findings; budget a small cleanup pass, or gate at a sensible level first. The code is small and already well-annotated, so this should be modest. relates: T-153
title: Add a static type check (mypy or pyright) to the dev pipeline
